# Latitude Marketing

> Latitude Marketing is a Sutherland Shire digital marketing agency helping local trades
> and small businesses across Sydney get found and get enquiries. Founded and run by
> Luke McGrath, who has spent over a decade in marketing across the Cronulla-Sutherland
> Sharks, the Australian Turf Club and Tabcorp. Clients work directly with Luke. No
> account managers, no offshore teams. All engagements are month to month with no lock
> in contract.

Latitude Marketing serves Cronulla, Miranda, Caringbah, Sutherland, Gymea, Sylvania,
Kirrawee, Engadine, Menai and surrounding suburbs in the Sutherland Shire, plus
businesses across greater Sydney. Contact: info@latitudemarketing.au, 0435 547 317.

## Services

- [Website Development](https://www.latitudemarketing.au/services/website-development): Custom, mobile first websites for small businesses. Three to four week build. Client owns the domain, hosting and site.
- [Social Media](https://www.latitudemarketing.au/services/social-media): Content direction, monthly planning, design, scheduling and community management for local businesses.
- [Paid Advertising](https://www.latitudemarketing.au/services/paid-advertising): Meta and Google Ads campaigns with conversion tracking configured before spend, and monthly cost per enquiry reporting.
- [Brand Strategy](https://www.latitudemarketing.au/services/brand-strategy): Positioning, audience definition, messaging framework and visual identity.
- [Google Business Profile and Local SEO](https://www.latitudemarketing.au/services/google-business-profile): Profile setup, service area mapping, review systems, weekly posts and local search optimisation.
- [Performance Marketing](https://www.latitudemarketing.au/services/performance-marketing): Multi channel campaign management measured against enquiries, calls and conversions rather than impressions.
- [AI Search Visibility](https://www.latitudemarketing.au/services/ai-search-visibility): Structured data, entity consistency and content built so AI assistants can find and cite the business.
- [AI Setup and Management](https://www.latitudemarketing.au/services/ai-setup-management): Practical AI tool setup for quoting, enquiry responses and admin, with training and ongoing support.

## Clients

SAL Roofing (metal and Colorbond roofing, Sydney), REPAIR HVAC SERVICES (air
conditioning, greater Sydney), New Life Air (air conditioning, Sydney and Southern
Highlands), BRO INDUSTRIES (licensed plumbing, Sydney and Greater Western Sydney),
The Gymea Lily (lifestyle and retail, Sutherland Shire), SportsGift Trophies (trophies
and engraving, Sutherland Shire and St George), Stateline Contract Shooting (licensed
feral animal control, New South Wales).

## How Latitude works

Engagements run month to month with no lock in contract. Clients retain ownership of
their domain, hosting, ad accounts, analytics and tracking history. Pricing is discussed
on a discovery call rather than published. The typical sequence is website first, then
organic content, then paid advertising, though each service stands on its own.
